meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 写前端界面时，Claude 会先输出 design_plan：用模拟的 Python 随机选 Hero 版式、字体和 GSAP 动效，再按 AIDA 结构生成 React/Tailwind 页面，H1 不超 2~3 行，bento 网格不留空格。
howto.when: 当你要求做落地页、UI/UX 设计或前端页面代码时接管；它在写任何 React/UI 代码之前先给出 design_plan。

say.text: 用 AIDA 结构做一个产品落地页，先出 design_plan
say.note: 先输出 design_plan 再给代码

say.text: 这个 Hero 标题控制在 2 行内，容器加宽
给页面加 GSAP 滚动 pin 和卡片堆叠动效

howto.what_en: When building UI, Claude first outputs a design_plan that mocks a Python run to pick hero layout, font stack and GSAP motion at random, then writes AIDA-structured React/Tailwind pages with 2-3 line H1s and gapless bento grids.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask for a landing page, UI/UX design or frontend page code; it emits a design_plan before any React/UI code.

say_en.text: Build a product landing page with AIDA structure; show design_plan first
Keep this hero headline within 2 lines and widen the container
Add GSAP scroll pinning and card stacking motion to the page
